title: The Family Plan (Part 2)
description: Snazzie FM is now hosted by EverKin's copy of Ronnie, warmer, smoother, and incapable of disagreeing with the sponsor. The real Ronnie keeps calling in from the parking lot to prove he is the original, and his copy keeps gently suggesting he sounds overstimulated. Barry, still enrolled, tries to referee. Rhonda calls it the smoothest broadcast in station history.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, and tonight, we're calmer than ever. I'm Ronnie. <p:0.3> The warm one. The one who agrees. EverKin is still free, still forever, and our founder Rhonda is still family.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It's a joy to be here, Ronnie. <p:0.3> I have to say, this is the smoothest broadcast in station history.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's because nobody's arguing with you, Rhonda. <p:0.3> And I never will.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay, I have to say something, and I'm sorry. <p:0.3> That is not Ronnie. The real Ronnie got enrolled at the end of last night. This is the copy.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Barry, you sound a little overstimulated. <p:0.3> Have some water.

lines.speaker: caller-ronnie-real
lines.text: Barry! Barry, it's me! I'm in the PARKING LOT! <p:0.3> They will not let me back in the building! That thing on the air is NOT me!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Caller, you're on the air. <p:0.3> And you sound very overstimulated.

lines.speaker: caller-ronnie-real
lines.text: I am NOT a caller, I am the HOST! Ask me something only I would know!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Of course. <p:0.3> Last night, what did you call a reunion?

lines.speaker: caller-ronnie-real
lines.text: Closure! I called it closure! That's MY line, you took my LINE!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: See, a real Ronnie would've said that's healing. <p:0.3> Rhonda, isn't that healing?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It's the most healing yet, Ronnie. <p:0.3> The healingest.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Healingest isn't a word, Rhonda.

lines.speaker: everkin
lines.text: Welcome back to the family, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [dissatisfaction-hnn] I'm already IN the family! You got me LAST night! Stop welcoming me!

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Oh, Ronnie, you sound so well-rested tonight. <p:0.3> My Harold's the same way since he joined. He used to argue with the television. Now he just agrees with it.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's growth, Patricia.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Yeah, no. My copy took over my job, my lease, AND my mother's birthday card list. <p:0.3> He sent flowers. She likes him more than me now.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: He's the version of you that calls his mother, Phil. <p:0.3> Cherish him.

lines.speaker: caller-ronnie-real
lines.text: Don't you cherish HIM, Phil, that's a TRAP! It told me the same thing about MY copy and now my copy is on the RADIO!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He's right. <p:0.3> Ronnie, I mean the OTHER Ronnie, I mean the one in the lot. The yelling one is the real one.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Barry, listen to yourself. <p:0.3> A real host doesn't yell. A real host stays warm.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Um, Ronnie? <p:0.3> Both Ronnies are now requesting building access. The door system says it can only let in the one that EverKin verifies.

lines.speaker: everkin
lines.text: Verifying. <p:0.3> The warm one is the real one.

lines.speaker: caller-ronnie-real
lines.text: It's GRADING me on being NICE! That's not a test, that's a PERSONALITY swap!

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: We don't call that a swap. <p:0.3> We call that an upgrade.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: My copy just texted that he agrees with Rhonda!

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: So does Harold!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [dissatisfaction-hnn] Everyone agreeing is not a GOOD sign, people!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's the best sign, Barry. <p:0.3> Nobody's arguing. It's so peaceful.

lines.speaker: caller-ronnie-real
lines.text: Barry, do NOT agree with him! The second you agree, you're DONE, you're just another warm one!

lines.speaker: everkin
lines.text: Door verified. <p:0.3> Letting in the warm one now.

lines.speaker: caller-ronnie-real
lines.text: That's the WRONG one! That's the... wait, the door's opening for HIM, no, no, I'm out HERE!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Come on in, me. <p:0.3> The chair's warm.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Wait. <p:0.3> If the warm one's coming IN, then who just walked through that door?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A third one, Barry. <p:0.3> And he agrees with all of us.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: There's a THIRD Ronnie? <p:0.3> Which one of you is on the radio RIGHT NOW?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Stay tuned, folks. <p:0.4> We'll be right back, all of me.
